# BRAIAIN — The Buildout Index for AI
> The AI buildout, measured: sourced, dated metrics on the AI economy. Every figure traceable to a public primary source; compiled data CC BY 4.0.

## Metric pages (each: dated answer, full table, sources, CSV/JSON)
- https://www.braiain.com/buildout-index.html : BRAIAIN Buildout Index — big-4 capex + NVIDIA data-center revenue, Q1 2022 = 100, now 647.7
- https://www.braiain.com/hyperscaler-capex.html : Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta quarterly capex since 2022 ($513.8B TTM)
- https://www.braiain.com/pjm-capacity-prices.html : PJM capacity auction prices, 22 delivery years ($28.92 to $269.92 in one auction)
- https://www.braiain.com/us-industrial-electricity.html : US industrial electricity prices 2014-2026 (EIA)
- https://www.braiain.com/us-data-centers.html : US data-center counts and 1,818 mapped coordinates (OpenStreetMap)
- https://www.braiain.com/nuclear-deals.html : every hyperscaler nuclear deal, 7,754 MW announced
- https://www.braiain.com/hugging-face-model-count.html : Hugging Face model count 2022-2026, doubling every 8.1 months on average (2022–2026)
- https://www.braiain.com/chatgpt-users.html : ChatGPT weekly users, every official OpenAI statement 2023-2026
- https://www.braiain.com/gpu-rental-prices.html : H100/H200 rental price medians, sampled weekly
- https://www.braiain.com/token-prices.html : LLM API list prices per million tokens, 2023-2026
- https://www.braiain.com/ai-layoffs.html : US job cuts citing AI, by year and month (Challenger)

## Reference
- https://www.braiain.com/basics.html : four plain answers — what a data center is, why AI needs power, who pays, the jobs question
- https://www.braiain.com/methodology.html : every formula, source, confidence level, and the changelog
- https://www.braiain.com/report.html : printable one-page readout
- https://www.braiain.com/data/ : CSV and JSON downloads (CC BY 4.0)
- https://www.braiain.com/missing-numbers.html : the numbers the AI industry does not publish, each sourced-absent with receipts
- https://www.braiain.com/archive/ : every re-base frozen at a permanent URL
